استنبطت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْبَطْتُ (istanbaṭtu) /is.tan.batˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# اِسْتَنْبَطْتَ (istanbaṭta) /is.tan.batˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# اِسْتَنْبَطْتِ (istanbaṭti) /is.tan.batˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# اِسْتَنْبَطَتْ (istanbaṭat) /i
